arguments.prompt:
Use the supplied ORIGINAL image as the character and outfit reference. Create ONE new supplementary professional character-design turnaround sheet. This is an original fictional adult, not a real person. Preserve the visible character from the input: warm brown skin, calm face and dark expressive eyes, chin-length dark brown bob with soft side part and clear face framing, relaxed adult build and understated neutral styling. Preserve the pale muted blue fine matte knit crew-neck sweater, charcoal wide woven trousers and simple brown ankle boots. Maintain this exact clothing direction and palette rather than redesigning the person.

Compose a spacious landscape page with THREE equal, complete full-length figures at the same scale and baseline, in this exact order and with simple labels: FRONT, PROFILE, BACK. FRONT is directly facing the viewer, PROFILE is a true90-degree side view facing the LEFT EDGE OF THE PAGE, BACK directly faces away. These must be three distinct views of the same figure, not front three-quarter portraits. Show every complete head and shoe with generous page margin. Arms hang naturally, slightly clear of the torso in the front/back views, hands relaxed and anatomically credible. Normal far hand or shoe overlap in the strict profile is fine.

Use the new profile and rear to deliberately DESIGN the previously unseen clothed shapes: a gently dropped shoulder seam with rounded shoulder depth; soft controlled full sleeves down to fitted ribbed wrist cuffs; an UNTUCKED ribbed sweater hem at upper hip, visibly covering the trouser waistband; a quiet plain sweater back with natural soft folds; comfortable trouser seat and hips leading into generous straight legs, restrained folds and a modest break onto the ankle boots. Keep the trousers loose, not skinny. Clearly distinguish the sweater hem, seat, leg ends, boot uppers, low practical heels and soles. Do not add rear-cardigan details, coat, jewelry, logos or busy decorative panels. Preserve the input's fine matte stitched knit interpretation instead of inventing large cables or exact branded boiled-wool claims.

Render as a polished realistic artist reference with consistent gentle neutral studio lighting and a quiet warm-gray background. The original front appearance remains the visual anchor. The new hidden clothed forms are authored design choices; the composition should make whole-figure side and rear proportions and overlap understandable without claiming measured or registered anatomy. No large portrait inset, fourth figure, action pose, furniture, crop, cutaway, wireframe or interface. Finish one coherent legible sheet, with each complete silhouette separated and labels aligned beneath.

expected_actual_outcome: one returned image with explicit defaultlocalpath; retain original and copy identical only after collection caps
